items.title: French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron
items.dek: Some cities including Lyon and Nice have banned all protests, and the French president said only authorised demos would be allowed.

items.title: Damaging hail pelts Phoenix in rare storm
items.dek: Videos from the Arizona capital show people sheltering inside a car as hail smashes the windscreen, while intense downpours covered neighbourhoods in ice.
